Ready to put AI to work: https://www.vendasta.com/lp-watch-demo?utm\_source=YouTube&utm\_medium=Video&utm\_content=uolZIg-b0qM  
  
Nick Vasilescu had zero followers and one month of runway left. He texted 50 people from his phone, booked 7 calls, and closed a $3,500 AI client in a week. Today he charges local businesses $5K a month, flat, and he walks through the math to a $1M AI agency with just 20 clients.  
  
In this episode of the Conquer Local podcast, Nick, a Y Combinator founder, explains why the real money in AI isn't in Silicon Valley. It's in agencies selling AI employees to the insurance agencies, design firms, and local businesses they already know how to serve.  
  
In this episode you'll learn:  
→ How to price AI employees at $5K/month with no setup fee and no token billing  
→ Why a $2M local business pays more, and stays longer, than a funded startup  
→ How to land your first AI client with no audience and no network  
→ The one question that replaces "what are your pain points?" on a discovery call  
→ How an AI agent did a $10K data job overnight for under $20  
→ The 5-part AI employee stack you can have live for a client in 24 hours  
→ Why you should sell AI as a revenue stream, not a time saver  
→ The cancellation that taught him how to stop churn  
  
ABOUT NICK  
Nick Vasilescu is the co-founder of Orgo, a Y Combinator-backed company that gives AI agents their own cloud computer so they're always running. He also sells AI employees directly to businesses.
